heading: PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AND WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
translated_text:
PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AND WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

REGIONAL GAZETTE

BANTUL REGENCY

No.15,2015 Family Welfare Agency, Women Empowerment and Family Planning of Bantul Regency.

heading: AMENDMENT TO REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY
Article I
heading_path: AMENDMENT TO REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY
translated_text:
Article I

Several provisions in Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence (Regional Gazette of Bantul Regency of 2013 Number 15, Supplement to the Regional Gazette of Bantul Regency Number 28), are amended as follows:

1. The provisions of Article 1 are amended, to read as follows:

heading: Article 1
heading_path: AMENDMENT TO REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY
translated_text:
Article 1

1. Government is the Central Government.
2. Region is Bantul Regency.
3. Regional Government is the Regent and Regional Apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Bantul Regency as an element of Regional Government administration.
5. Regent is the Regent of Bantul.
6. Regional Apparatus Work Unit hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD, is the regional apparatus work unit of Bantul Regency.
7. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
8. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child still in the womb.
9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological, threat of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life against victims.
10. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, economically, and other violence.
12. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.
13. Psychological Violence is any act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
14. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
15. Economic Violence is any act that neglects family members in the form of not providing proper living care or maintenance.
16. Exploitation of Children is any act involving children in activities that may harm their welfare and development or endanger the safety of children with the aim of enabling others to obtain economic, sexual, social, or political benefits, including if it contains restrictions or elimination of opportunities for children to obtain their rights.
17. Sexual harassment is any action with sexual nuances conveyed through physical or non-physical contact that targets sexual body parts or a person's sexuality, including by using whistles, winking, comments or words with sexual nuances, displaying pornographic materials and sexual desires, pinching or touching body parts, movements or gestures that are sexual in nature resulting in feelings of discomfort, offense, feeling degraded in dignity, and possibly causing health and safety problems.
18. Victim is a Child and Woman who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Bantul Regency.
19. Prevention is a direct effort carried out by the Regional Government to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
20. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security for women carried out by family members, the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
22. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
24. Women's Empowerment is any effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social capacity, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
25. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
26. Spiritual guidance is accompaniment in the form of services for spiritual strengthening so that sick people can rise to be closer to God so that feelings of calm, security arise, and become mentally healthy.
27. Judicial body is a general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice.
28. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in the manner and according to the procedure regulated by law with a request that it be examined and decided by a judge in a court session.
29. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him civilly.
30. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance to victims of violence.
31. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence.
32. Regional Action Plan is the foundation and guideline for relevant agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the implementation of prevention and protection of children and women victims of violence.
33. Safe House is a shelter for victims, during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators in accordance with predetermined standards.
34. Social Reintegration is the process of preparing the community and victims that supports the reunification of victims into the family environment, family substitutes who can provide protection and fulfillment of victims' needs.
35. Standard Operating Procedure hereinafter abbreviated as SOP is the standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaints/identification, rehabilitation, health, social rehabilitation, legal services up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.
36. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.
37. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers and reside in that household.
38. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
39. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget hereinafter abbreviated as APBD is the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget of Bantul Regency.
40. Gender responsive budget is a budget that provides and accommodates justice and equality for women and men to access and obtain access, as well as benefits from development programs and participate in decision-making processes and have control over resources.
41. Forum for Protection of Violence Victims hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against Children and Women whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.

heading: Article 13

translated_text:
Article 13

1. In order to provide services and protection to victims of acts of violence, the Regional Government establishes PPT.
2. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) has the duties, principal tasks, and functions of providing protection to Children and Women from acts of violence, consisting of fields.
3. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) is tasked with providing services and protection to children and women victims of violence.
4. In the event that PPT does not have facilities to provide services and protection as referred to in paragraph (3), then children and women victims of violence are referred through a network system within the FPKK forum.
5. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) is established by Regent Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER VII
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 43

1. The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of PPT Minimum Service Standards.
2. Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.
5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is conducted by SKPD in charge of women's empowerment and child protection.
6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d is conducted periodically.

12. The provisions of Article 43 are amended to become Article 44 to read as follows:

heading: CHAPTER VIII
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Article 44

1. PPT and FPKK prepare reports on the protection of Children and Women victims of acts of violence to the Regent.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted in writing, covering:
a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and
d. performance.
3. Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out at least once every 3 (three) months and is organized in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

18. An explanation of Article 31 letter b is added to read as set forth in the explanation of this Regional Regulation.

19. An explanation of Article 43 paragraph (6) is added to read as set forth in the explanation of this Regional Regulation.

heading: ELUCIDATION OF REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION OF REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY

NUMBER 15 OF 2015 CONCERNING AMENDMENT TO REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY NUMBER 15 OF 2013 CONCERNING PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AND WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

heading: I. GENERAL
heading_path: ELUCIDATION OF REGIONAL REGULATION OF BANTUL REGENCY
translated_text:
I. GENERAL

As a manifestation of the Regional Government's responsibility in taking action both legally, politically, economically and socially to prevent, suppress, reduce, and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence has been enacted.

Up to the present time the said Regional Regulation has been implemented in the administration of regional government. However, in accordance with the mechanism for supervision of regional legal products, the Regional Government of the Special Region of Yogyakarta has provided clarification on Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence. From the results of the said clarification, there are several substantive changes that must be followed up with an Amendment to the Regional Regulation.

Based on the above considerations, Regional Regulation of Bantul Regency Number 15 of 2013 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence needs to be amended in its Articles and elucidation.

heading: Article 2

translated_text:
Article 2

Letter a
What is meant by "respect and fulfillment of the rights of victims" is a series of actions to respect, appreciate and ensure the fulfillment of the rights of victims.

Letter b
What is meant by "justice and gender equality" is a process to be fair to men and women and equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so as to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, national defense and security activities and equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Letter c
What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions on the basis of age, sex, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

Letter d
What is meant by "the best interests of the victim" is that all actions of recovery, rehabilitation, reunification concerning victims carried out by the government, society, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, must be the primary consideration.

Letter e
What is meant by "empowerment" is the strengthening of victims of violence to be able to work and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

heading: Article 3

translated_text:
Article 3

Paragraph (1)
Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (2)
Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (3)
Letter a
What is meant by the "prevention" aspect is a protection strategy effort through:
a. Primary prevention, all people, families, communities and the state in efforts to increase the ability of knowledge, understanding and to ensure that violence against women and children does not occur, including socialization of policies, adequate services, supportive workplace policies, and life skills training for women and children. What is meant by life skills training includes conflict resolution without violence, stress management skills, resource management, effective decision making, effective interpersonal communication, guidance on the psychosocial development of women and children.

b. Secondary prevention, aimed at community groups with high risk in efforts to improve skills, including training and victim services to ensure that violence against women and children does not occur in the next generation.

Activities carried out here include conducting home visits for parents who have just had children to conduct self-assessment of whether they are at risk of committing violence against children in the future.

c. Tertiary prevention, intended to improve parenting abilities that ensure that violence against women and children is not repeated, here what is done is integrated services for women and children who are victims of violence, through counseling, stress management training.

Letter b
What is meant by the "service and assistance" aspect is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals and assistants in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.

Letter c
Sufficiently clear.

Letter d
What is meant by the "empowerment" aspect is the process of increasing the role of the community to participate in the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence which aims to obtain access and participation in the process of protection of women and children broadly.

translated_text:
Article 25

Paragraph (1)
Sufficiently clear

Paragraph (2)
Point a
What is meant by "network" includes family partners, dasawisma, family groups existing in the community.

What is meant by "coordination" includes planning, implementation and monitoring of violence prevention programs.

Point b
What is meant by "violence prevention system" includes mapping of locations or areas prone to violence and carrying out promotive and preventive efforts to the community.

Point c
What is meant by "Critical education on the rights of children and women" is an effort to build awareness of children and women about their rights.

The purpose of implementing critical education is to be able to help make decisions and not become victims of repeated violence.

Forms of critical education for the community consist of: training on gender equality and justice, education on reproductive health for women, and providing understanding of laws and regulations on the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Child Protection.

Point d
Socialization can be carried out through mass media, electronic media, and direct counseling to the community.

Point c

Point d

Point e

Point f
Sufficiently clear.

Point h
